title: OnboardingState requires orgId and enforces a unique index per org
description: onboarding-state.model.js declares orgId as required with a unique index (one OnboardingState document per organization). Mirrors the existing suite at vibrantix-backend/tests/modules/onboarding-state.model.test.js.
steps: Attempt to validate() a new OnboardingState document with no orgId
Create an OnboardingState for a given orgId, then attempt to create a second document for the same orgId
expectedResult: The first validate() rejects with an orgId-required error. The second create() rejects with a duplicate-key error from the unique orgId index.

title: setupHealthScore is clamped to the 0-100 range at the schema level
steps: Build an OnboardingState with setupHealthScore = 150 and call validate()
Build an OnboardingState with setupHealthScore = -1 and call validate()
expectedResult: Both validate() calls reject — the schema's min:0/max:100 constraints on setupHealthScore are enforced.

title: currentStep only accepts the 6 declared enum values
description: STEPS = ['step-1','step-2','step-3','step-4','step-5','complete'] in onboarding-state.model.js. Any other string must fail schema validation.
steps: Build an OnboardingState with currentStep = 'step-99' and call validate()
Iterate all 6 values in the exported STEPS constant and validate() each as currentStep
expectedResult: 'step-99' is rejected. All 6 exported STEPS values (including 'complete') validate successfully.

title: compute() sums per-step weights and caps the total at 100
description: setup-health.service.js WEIGHTS: step-1=10, step-2=20, step-3=30, step-4=15, step-5=0, plus +25 when firstScanAt is set. Score is persisted via updateOne after every compute().
preconditions: An OnboardingState with completedSteps = ['step-1','step-2','step-3','step-4','step-5'] and firstScanAt set
steps: Call compute(orgId) for the org above
expectedResult: compute() returns 100 (10+20+30+15+0+25, capped at 100) and the same value is persisted to setupHealthScore on the document.

title: Completing all 5 wizard steps without a successful cloud scan only reaches 75%, not 100%
description: step-5's weight is 0 — its 25 points come solely from firstScanAt being set (setup-health.service.js line 18/34-35), not from completing the wizard. If the org never had a successful Prowler scan (e.g. cloud connect was skipped in step-3), the score plateaus at 10+20+30+15=75 even with completedSteps containing all 5 steps.
preconditions: firstScanAt is null (cloud connect was skipped or no scan has completed yet)
steps: Call compute(orgId) for the org above
expectedResult: compute() returns 75, not 100 — confirming the score is not simply '(completedSteps.length / 5) * 100' and depends on the independent firstScanAt milestone.

title: nextStep() returns the first missing step in ORDERED_STEPS regardless of completion order
description: onboarding.controller.js's local nextStep(completedSteps) helper iterates ORDERED_STEPS = ['step-1'..'step-5'] and returns the first entry not present in completedSteps, or 'complete' if all are present. Completion order is not tracked — only set membership.
steps: Call nextStep(['step-3']) — step-3 completed out of order, steps 1/2/4/5 still missing
expectedResult: nextStep(['step-3']) returns 'step-1' (the first missing step in order, not step-4). nextStep with all 5 present returns 'complete'.

title: Stepper renders a checkmark and green fill only for steps present in completedSteps
description: Stepper.jsx (components/onboarding/Stepper.jsx) computes isDone = completedSteps.includes(step.key) and isCurrent = currentStep === step.key independently — a step can be isDone without being isCurrent (e.g. after moving past it) and the reverse (isCurrent but not isDone).
expectedResult: Steps 1 and 2 show the green doneBg circle with a CheckIcon; step 3 shows the activeBg circle with the number '3', not a checkmark; steps 4 and 5 show pendingBg with their numbers.

title: SetupChecklist renders null once setupHealthScore reaches 100
description: SetupChecklist.jsx line 42: 'if (state.setupHealthScore >= 100) return null;' — the widget unmounts entirely rather than showing a completed/100% state.
steps: Render <SetupChecklist /> with a mocked onboardingService.getState() resolving { setupHealthScore: 100, completedSteps: [...] }
expectedResult: The component renders nothing (no DOM node) — there is no 'all done' celebratory state, it simply disappears.
